algorithm: PDDM: ensemble of feed-forward dynamics models + MPPI-style filtering/reward-weighted-refinement trajectory optimizer (no policy network, no policy-gradient training)
hand: Shadow Hand (24-DoF, real and sim); D'Claw (9-DoF, sim only, valve turning)
arm: none for manipulation; a 7-DoF Franka-Emika arm only runs the automated Baoding-ball reset and never manipulates the task object
success_criterion: episode terminates at a 10 s task horizon or on a drop; success = completing the commanded 90 deg or 180 deg Baoding-ball rotation within 10 s without dropping either ball
headline_value: about 100% success on 90 deg rotation and about 54% on 180 deg rotation (Fig. 9, Sec 4.4)
paper_code_mismatch: Table 2 states obs-dim 46 for In-hand Reorientation while the released cube_env.py code sums to 39; the Baoding reward code includes an extra -10*wrist_too_high term absent from Table 2's printed formula.
